project.warning: StarletteDeprecationWarning: httpx TestClient support deprecated; install httpx2 instead

browserAttempts.failure: Silent-socket recovery assertion missed the one-second Disconnected label; page had already reached Transport: Awaiting stream evidence. Actions were disabled, ladder empty, source readiness unavailable, chart evidence cleared.
browserAttempts.resolution: Assert durable invalidation and actionable terminal/transport incident instead of transient wording; arm replacement-session/view response listeners before suppressing native socket traffic.

browserAttempts.scope: Full actual offline backend suite; expected network-only skip

clockStepRegression.name: truncated clock coverage retains readable time at its only step marker
clockStepRegression.behavior: A native discontinuity marker retains readable projected clock time even when no ordinary aligned tick fits the retained mapping interval.

browserFinal.scope: Actual offline backend; network-only scenario intentionally skipped; separate public-live observations retained.

review.chartContracts: No remaining findings; footprint center memoized. Unsupported same-session clock cutover findings withdrawn against writer/reader, demo and immutable live ReceiveBoundary contracts.
review.measurementLifecycle: Independent review found no findings after exact-request failure race, navigate-away/bounded reader drain before context closure, and known-HTTP-error cancellation guard. Cohort failures and 250ms budget remain unchanged.
